title: Kusanagi Nene — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, please take your seats.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Phew... I thought I'd be late since I lost track of time at home, but I somehow made it...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Now, just as I announced last time, today is the day you will select your committees for the year.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Right. We're supposed to make our committee choices today...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But there aren't any that I really feel like joining...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Either way, I'm guessing we'll have to draw straws or something if no one volunteers for some of them...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Now, do any of you wish to become the class representative?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Yes, I do!
I heard it looks great on your transcript!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Then, maybe I should too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(That's such a terrible reason!
And they're seriously saying it right in front of the teacher?!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why not volunteer, Akito?
I bet your transcript needs it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look who's talking.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Excellent. This is going smoother than expected. Next, how about the planning committees for the School Festival and the Sports Festival?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Ooh!
We wanna work on the School Festival!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: We've been wanting to be on the Sports Festival's committee since last year! Please pick us!!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh... As your teacher, I am moved by your enthusiasm, but ten candidates is pushing it. Could you talk amongst yourselves and whittle it down to two per committee?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Just two?!
But we've been preparing for this since last year!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Oh well...
I guess we have no choice but to compete for those seats!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. They all seem really motivated.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So many people want to be on the planning committees...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Things are so different when your class is full of extroverts...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, onto our final committee...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Finalizing the planning committees took up a lot of time, but everything else went pretty smoothly. Just one more...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone is pretty eager, so I'm sure someone will volunteer. I'm probably safe.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Last but not least, the library committee!
Who would like to join?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What?!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So no one's gonna raise their hand?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: I mean, I don't know much about books...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Yeah, someone who likes reading and stuff should be on it, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (After causing such a fuss over the planning committees...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But if no one raises their hand...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hmm... We'll have to draw straws for this one. As it so happens, there's quite a bit of history behind that. It has even been used to decide the Shogun and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, a lot of other people aren't on a committee yet. The chances of me being picked should be low...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I should be off the hook.)
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't believe I was picked...
I mean, what are the odds...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Although, this could be a good opportunity to read some more books about singing and acting...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll try to have a positive attitude and make the most of it...)
